scope: Static compiled shader arithmetic and local GLSL reconstruction. CPU dispatch/bindings, native samplers, actual Leona variant selection and native frames remain unverified.

findings.observation: Pre-tint source/lookup alpha carries interpolated rim RGB; RGB clamps to [0,1]. Particle tint alpha does not carry the rim.
Erosion samples transformed base UVs, clamps channel dot, computes the feathered band and multiplies only base*tint alpha. Rim uses original base alpha.
Global remap samples luma at row .5; positive remap alpha replaces RGB, while output alpha remains base*lookup*tint alpha.

vertex.observation: Vertex world normal and view ray produce clamped facing; COLOR0 is (1-pow(facing,vFresnel.w))*vFresnel.rgb.

localChoices: No authored skin color lookup is treated as a neutral binding.
No authored reflection cube map draws the rim alone.
Global remap is bypassed unless explicitly provided.
WebGL polygon offset -1/-1 approximates the authored depth bias.
Missing erosion sampler/mixer/feather/slice defaults follow the pinned external reconstruction.
